verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online documents several background automations: automated payment reminders, auto-recording and matching of invoice payments, automatic bank and transaction imports, and automatic expense sorting. Advanced also offers custom workflows, a community user confirms rule-based categorization, and Payroll AI proactively collects time data and texts updates. However, the evidence is one-line marketing claims, and the Intuit Intelligence AI is chat-driven on request rather than shown setting up autonomous agentic jobs. Missing for 10: documentation of how users configure or schedule custom workflows/rules, evidence of AI agents running user-defined multi-step tasks autonomously, hands-on corroboration of background reliability.
